text:
sasha: Quick ping on continuous-batcher experiment idea: add a tiny per-tenant fastpath credit (micro-slab) + enqueue pacing to reduce eviction spikes during microbursts. want quick takes on downside and measurability. :thinking:

kevin: sounds useful. main downside is more moving parts in admission. need clear metrics to know if it helps. :eyes:

li: how do you picture the pacing working? token buckets or slot windows?

sasha: two soft levers: 1) per-tenant pacing (token-bucket style) to smooth enqueue rates into coalesce windows, 2) micro-slab = small fast-path credit pool per tenant that lets very short requests bypass normal eviction for lower latency. slabs are stealable when idle.

anna: prefer credit budget over fixed slots to avoid wasted capacity on low-traffic tenants. but slots are simpler to reason about. tradeoff noted.

kevin: interaction with preemption/fallback is tricky. if a node fails we must have deterministic slab drain -> shared pool transition.

sasha: plan: on drain slab credits return to shared pool first; pacing stops allowing enqueue into regular pool. canary policy gives lower initial slab to new tenants.

li: we need observability before rollout: per-tenant slab usage, pacing-blocked rate, reclaim events, eviction rate by tenant.

sasha: agreed. proposed config prototype (rough):

```
batcher:
  micro_fastpath:
    pacing_rate: 400 # tokens/sec default per tenant
    slab_tokens: 64   # fast-path credit tokens
    slab_refill_secs: 60
    slab_stealable: true
    eviction_mode: soft_lru
```

kevin: for experiments run A/B with synthetic microburst traffic (20-200 token requests) on subset of tenants. capture p50/p95/p99 token lat and batch size distributions.

anna: ops concerns: larger config surface. suggest sane defaults + auto-tune: e.g. set pacing_rate = 1.5 * moving_avg_token_rate, slab_tokens = 0.5 * p95_batch_tokens.

sasha: next steps: instrument current batcher to emit the metrics li asked for; kevin will own benchmark harness, anna will add telemetry and alerts. i'll draft RFC after a first bench run.

kevin: I'll spin up harness and post numbers in ~48h.

anna: I'll add dashboard tiles and alerts: alert if eviction_rate rises >5% or test-tenant p95 token latency increases >20%.

li: sounds like RFC-worthy change. include failure modes and rollout plan.

sasha: will draft short RFC with invariants, failure cases, and rollback. aim for RFC next week if bench looks good.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch "fastpath-slab-proto" build 1427. :rocket:

kevin: FYI I'll include raw traces and replay scripts in the RFC.

sasha: thanks everyone. main goal: smooth eviction storms and reduce microburst tail without harming throughput. will report results. :thumbsup:
